scoring_method: Observable structural signals from local clone analysis. 12 dimensions scored 0-100. Dimensions selected to be fair across three fundamentally different project categories (AI agent, AI assistant, orchestration framework).

dimensions.name: Agent Architecture Depth
dimensions.signals_h: Single AIAgent class with subagent delegation. Synchronous loop. Smart routing.
dimensions.signals_oc: Distributed agent logic. Plugin hooks. ~5 agent-like components.
dimensions.signals_sh: 473 specialist agents, 53 squads, chief-specialist hierarchy, authority matrix, handoff protocols, swarm-execute.

dimensions.name: Self-Improvement & Learning
dimensions.signals_h: Self-creating skills, self-improving during use, memory nudges, Honcho user modeling, trajectory compression.
dimensions.signals_oc: Skills + memory plugins. No self-improvement loop.
dimensions.signals_sh: Declarative agents. No self-modification. Improvement via human-driven story cycles.

dimensions.name: Governance & Quality Control
dimensions.signals_oc: AGENTS.md boundaries, plugin contracts, 70% coverage, drift detection, CODEOWNERS.
dimensions.signals_sh: Constitution (322 lines), CODEOWNERS, 5 rules, 10 hooks, 621 templates, 483 checklists, 1834 tasks, 185 stories, artifact classification, Local-CI parity policy.

dimensions.name: Knowledge Management
dimensions.signals_h: Skills as procedural memory. FTS5 session search. Honcho user profiles. 116 skills.
dimensions.signals_oc: 53 skills. ClawHub. Memory plugins. Plugin docs.
dimensions.signals_sh: 8-layer framework. 5-layer workspace per business. Document Registry with lifecycle. 1809 data files. Token registry. Composition rules. SYNAPSE context engine.

dimensions.name: Multi-Platform & Channels
dimensions.signals_h: 17 messaging platforms. 6 terminal backends. No native apps.
dimensions.signals_oc: 23+ channels. Native apps (macOS/iOS/Android). Canvas. Voice. WebChat.
dimensions.signals_sh: CLI-first (constitutional). No messaging. No native apps. Claude Code integration only.

dimensions.name: Extensibility & Plugin Model
dimensions.signals_h: registry.register() pattern. 49 tools. Toolsets for composition. No formal SDK.
dimensions.signals_oc: Plugin SDK with 50+ subpath exports. Manifest lifecycle. npm distribution. 93 extensions. Import boundaries.
dimensions.signals_sh: Squad-based extensibility. New squads via squad-creator. Agent definitions in Markdown YAML. 53 squads. Templates + checklists + tasks as extension mechanism.

dimensions.name: Business & Multi-Tenant Architecture
dimensions.signals_sh: 4 businesses (AllFluence, AIOX, Academia Lendaria, Billion). Hub-and-Spoke. Data isolation. Per-business workspace L0-L4. CODEOWNERS per business. Shared products with 33/33/33 split.

dimensions.name: Research & Training Infrastructure
dimensions.signals_h: Batch runner, Atropos RL, trajectory compression, SWE-bench, 11 model parsers, datagen configs.
dimensions.signals_sh: Runner-lib with multi-model benchmarks. Score trends. Run history. But no RL/trajectory infrastructure.

dimensions.name: Developer Experience
dimensions.signals_h: curl installer, setup wizard, doctor, skin engine, migration tool, ACP.
dimensions.signals_oc: npm install, onboard wizard, doctor, dev channels, Oxlint/Oxfmt, pre-commit, boundary AGENTS.md.
dimensions.signals_sh: CLAUDE.md comprehensive, reference rules on-demand, validate scripts, pre-push hooks, gotchas documented. But steep learning curve (8 layers, 53 squads).

dimensions.name: Testing & CI
dimensions.signals_h: 400 tests, pytest, parallel. No coverage threshold. 6 CI workflows.
dimensions.signals_oc: 3534 tests, Vitest, 70% coverage, E2E, drift detection, 13 CI workflows.
dimensions.signals_sh: 204 tests (shell), YAML validation, squad structure validation, 5 CI workflows. Local-CI parity policy formal but limited test coverage.

dimensions.name: Content & Documentation Scale
dimensions.signals_h: Docusaurus site, 438 md files, release notes. AGENTS.md as dev guide.
dimensions.signals_oc: Mintlify docs (877 md), CHANGELOG (965K bytes), zh-CN + ja-JP i18n, VISION.md.
dimensions.signals_sh: 16,703 md files, 5.97M md LOC, 7,597 yaml files, 2.65M yaml LOC. 185 stories. 621 templates. Framework-as-documentation.

dimensions.name: Community & Ecosystem
dimensions.signals_h: 202 contributors, agentskills.io, Nous Research, MIT, Discord.
dimensions.signals_oc: 1584 contributors, OpenAI/GitHub/NVIDIA/Vercel sponsors, ClawHub, MIT, 3 dev channels.
dimensions.signals_sh: 4 contributors (founders), private repo, internal ecosystem. Squads as community substitute.
